supersedes.old_rule: point-in-time nominal prior completed-day close <= JPY 1000
supersedes.new_rule: price ceiling is an experimental policy, not a mandatory eligibility condition

user_goal: Performance first. Keep a JPY1000 cap only if it improves clean out-of-sample performance versus no price ceiling.

common_contract.absolute_features: use point-in-time nominal prices for log_price / any absolute-price feature
common_contract.relative_features: use causal split-normalized series for ratios/returns/technicals
common_contract.target: next official XTKS open after signal date -> D+5 official close
common_contract.architecture: exact frozen V11 3-head model/selector from consensus_v47_clean_pit_preregister.json
common_contract.atr_gate: none in primary comparison; old 2.864 cap is diagnostic only

CAP1000_PIT.rule: point-in-time nominal prior completed-day close <= JPY 1000
CAP1000_PIT.role: legacy-like price-focus arm retained only if it earns its place on clean data

prohibited_initial_search: Do not test JPY500, JPY1500, JPY2000 or other price ceilings in the initial decision.
Do not add a price floor from the already-opened contaminated price-bucket analysis.
Do not choose a cap using V43/V44 contaminated returns.
Do not use 2026 returns to choose the price policy.

selection_protocol.operational_view: one position per symbol; 5 official trading-session no-overlap stress; no replacement
selection_protocol.primary_metric: mean canonical 5BD return after 0.5% round-trip cost
development_choice: Require at least 20 valid development trades under the operational view.
Choose the arm with higher development primary_metric.
If absolute mean difference < 0.50 percentage points, choose higher Top3-excluded mean.
If still tied within 0.25 percentage points, choose higher median.
If still tied, choose NOCAP because it is the simpler rule.
locked_validation: After the development winner is frozen, open H2 performance for the winner.
Do not use the losing arm's H2 return to switch policies.
Validation passes for continued research if H2 mean after 0.5% cost > 0.

Top3-excluded mean, median, hit10/hit20, loss10/loss20, symbol concentration and monthly/weekly concentration are mandatory diagnostics but are not automatic vetoes solely because the system is allowed to capture rare monster winners.

performance_philosophy: Headline performance is the primary objective.
Robustness diagnostics are used to detect fake performance / concentration, not to force a low-volatility low-return system.
A rare large-winner contribution is acceptable if it is generated causally and survives the locked validation contract.
Simplicity wins ties: do not retain the JPY1000 restriction unless it demonstrably improves clean performance.
follow_up_only_if_both_weak: If both NOCAP and CAP1000_PIT fail clean H2, do not grid-search price caps. Revisit the model/family, not the price threshold.
